thread:
linda (People Ops): Idea: a 'Welcome Wagon' kit for newly promoted managers 1 small surprise kit + instructions on how to nominate peers. Goal: 50 in-office kits + 30 remote e-kits next month. Need budgeting, packing volunteers, and a PO flow. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

tom (Logistics): I can coordinate packing. What's in the kit?

linda (People Ops): Proposal: 1 x $5 spot token (physical), 1 x handwritten welcome card, 1 x set of stickers, 1 x snack, 1 x quick-start checklist postcard. Remote = $8 e-gift + digital checklist.

priya (Finance): Ballpark cost? If < $12/kit excl. shipping we can use culture fund. Need vendor invoice + tax ID before PO. Code to GL 4-215.

marc (Hiring): We'll provide recipient CSV (start date, office/remote, email). Will exclude contractors. ETA for CSV: Tue noon.

jen (Remote Ops): For remote deliveries I'll need email + timezone column. I can batch-send e-gifts in 2 waves to avoid odd hours. Please add to sheet.

sticker-bot: Print run request: 80 sticker sheets queued. Estimated print ETA 48 hrs. :printer:

tom (Logistics): Volunteers for packing at SF warehouse Thurs 9-11am: need 4 people. I can bring tape + label printer.

linda (People Ops): Volunteers: linda, tom, marc, rafael (Events), emily (People Ops) so far. Need one more for HQ.

priya (Finance): Keep receipts in the sheet uploads tab. If total > $1,200 escalate. Also add note on internal packing slip: 'GL 4-215; retain receipts for audit.'

linda (People Ops): Packing slip draft: "Welcome to your new role! Pop into #gratitude to shout out someone who helped you along the way." Proofread please.

marc (Hiring): Wording good. Suggest adding link to quick-start doc: https://redwood.company/welcome-manager-guide

jen (Remote Ops): I'll pull remote list once CSV is posted and DM confirmations post-send.

linda (People Ops): Great. Tom please confirm pickup window with vendor and post tracking. I'll lock counts by Wed EOD and upload invoice. Thanks all :sparkles:
